intro.title: A clear route from buyer brief to supplier check
intro.p1: Ningxin Trading provides China sourcing and export coordination for overseas buyers evaluating fibre, cable and related supply. We coordinate the supplier conversation; we do not manufacture the products we quote.
intro.p2: Send the product, quantity, destination and document requirements. We organize the information needed for a supplier quotation.
intro.p3: The quotation sets out its product scope, origin, documentation and commercial terms.
